summary: Iteration 2 verifies the major freresglobal.com redesign. Backend: 10/10 pytest passing (health, catalog legacy slugs still served, inquiry validation, create+persist, plus 4 new interest slugs workstations-laptops / pos-retail / storage-components / servers-datacenter all accepted and persisted with status 201 & GET round-trip). Frontend: Nav logo image renders, all 5 nav links (home/solutions/partners/footprint/contact) present, hero title reads 'Enterprise hardware, Dubai to Ghana, shipped without friction.', 4 solution cards render with correct slugs and Request Spec & Pricing Quote CTAs, all 9 partner wordmarks (Lenovo, Dell, HP, HPE, ASUS, Orderman, Western Digital, SanDisk, Kingston) rendered, Regional Footprint section with hub-dubai, hub-accra and corridor-stat-0/1 rendered. Clicking cta-quote-pos-retail sets location.hash to #contact?interest=pos-retail and preselects the interest-pos-retail chip (bg-white text-black classes verified). Contact form submitted via UI returned success toast (POST /api/inquiries 201 via network). Mobile menu opens and closes correctly at 390px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py Inquiry.interest comment still lists old slugs (laptops|workstations|servers|desktops|storage|parts|services); frontend now sends new slugs (workstations-laptops, pos-retail, storage-components, servers-datacenter, services). Since the field is a free-form str it still works, but the comment is stale. Also /api/catalog still returns the old 6 category slugs — noted in review as intentional and unused by frontend.
created_at is stored as ISO string in Mongo; consider native BSON datetime for proper sort at scale (carried over from iteration 1).
Deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — prefer FastAPI lifespan handler (carried over).
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed inquiries created for each new interest slug plus one via UI (test_pw@freresglobal-test.com). No delete endpoint; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://systems-hub-7.preview.emergentagent.com. All redesign features verified. Contact form testids: input-name, input-email, input-company, input-message, submit-inquiry, interest-<slug>. Interest slugs on frontend: workstations-laptops, pos-retail, storage-components, servers-datacenter, services. CTA anchor pattern is #contact?interest=<slug>; Contact component parses via hashchange listener. Mobile menu appears at <lg breakpoint (390px works).
